claims.content: The customer has items in their My Watch List in which they are interested but not bidding on.
The My Watch List page is accessible via the vanity URL www.jtvauctions.com/mywatchlist.
The customer opens the My Watch List page to monitor the status of items they are interested in but not bidding on.

trigger.raw_text: The customer opens the My Watch List page to monitor the status of items they are interested in but not bidding on.

claims.content: When an auction ends and the customer has stored credit card information, the system will automatically process the order upon winning and send the winner an order confirmation email.

When an auction ends and the customer has PayPal or Amazon Payments as the default payment method in their registration information, the order will be placed in a Hold status until payment is received; the customer will be sent an email requiring payment, and if payment is not received within 168 hours, the item order will be cancelled.
The system displays the My Watch List page, which is a list of items the customer is interested in but not bidding on.
The data on the My Watch List page is sortable by clicking on the column headers, with the initial default sort by ending time, soonest on top.
The JTV Current Date/Time is displayed dynamically on the My Watch List page without refreshing by the user.
The Item # on the My Watch List page is linked to the Product Details (Bidding) page.
The Bid button on the My Watch List page is linked to the Product Details (Bidding) page.
The My Watch List page includes a link to the Recently Ended Auctions page.
The My Watch List page uses the global site header & footer and does not include Endeca navigation.
